$comment: Third-party agent harnesses for the dev3d office. This file is deliberately
It exists because DEV3D_VENDORS_CONFIG names it, and a pointed-at file that
is absent is reported at every boot. An empty `vendors` array is the honest
answer: the setting is satisfied and no harness is configured.
For one or two presets, DEV3D_VENDORS in .env is usually enough -
for anything that needs a different binary, extra arguments, a longer
timeout, or a vendor with no preset at all. It wins on an id collision with
DEV3D_VENDORS, because it is the richer source.
